personal.bio: Passionate about video game creation, I'm a versatile developer specialized in gameplay mechanics, visual design, and game production. Self-taught, I started by creating additional content for games, which gave me a deep understanding of development processes. Currently a 3rd-year student at IUT Montpellier-Sète in the IAMSI program (Application Integration and Information Systems Management), I'm refining my skills in project management and technical development. My ambition: to become a team lead capable of driving ambitious game productions to success.
